<!--
  An experiment NEVER carries a milestone (PLAYBOOK §4, PM003). It feeds the release spine;
  it never rides it. If its verdict commits work, file THAT work as its own issue.

  Its gates are created by DECISION rather than by milestone, because the mechanical trigger
  can never fire for something unmilestoned:

      pm-playbook materialize --issue <this> --yes

  An experiment with no gates means NOT STARTED. That is a legitimate state — file it and
  leave it until you actually pick it up.
-->

<!-- If the answer changes nothing, this is not worth running. -->
